name: B10-0340/2025 (PPE) – Case of Ryan Cornelius in Dubai
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Ryan Cornelius in Dubai
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for the immediate and unconditional release of Ryan Cornelius, a 71-year-old British man held in Dubai since 2008. It says his trial was unfair, his sentence was extended retroactively, and his conditions amount to torture. It asks the United Arab Emirates to let independent doctors examine him, provide treatment, pay him reparations, and stop imprisoning people over debt. It also urges the United Kingdom and European Union officials to raise his case.

- Nothing changes yet; this is the Parliament's formal request, not a law.
- It concerns Ryan Cornelius, his family, and the United Arab Emirates authorities.
- European Union officials and member states are asked to raise his case with the Emirates.
